reviews.comment: He was the absolute worst. Good luck on your exams, or rather, good luck memorizing literally everything.

Balawi gave us a quiz where he removed a term from an equation sheet to see if we would catch it.  He also had to give 5/30 points bonus on quizzes because the class averages were failing.  Also doesn't give us insight into the exams and tells us to study the whole class for the final with a 4 page equation sheet.  Not kind.
Makes his exams super hard compared to quizzes and homeworks. Does not go into depth on the stuff he asks about. Super harsh grader. Will not compromise on anything and no mercy on anything.

I think part of it is how this class is structured, but I think there are professors that are better suited for this class. Professor Balawi is a very nice guy, but there were many times I thought that he had no idea what he was talking about in this class. He is not very accesible outside of class as he doesn't respond to his email well at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Balawi makes his lectures super fun for 8-9 am. He wants you to be awake and learn the material, and he really cares about your success. The class never really gets harder (The exams are tough but if you do everything else you'll be fine). Enjoy 360 as it is one of the most fun classes imo. Would definitely take him again.

Dr. Balawi is a great professor with a lively and enthusiastic personality. He cares about your learning and is willing to help you if you reach out to him. Make sure to get a good group for group projects because they matter a lot. Other than that, pay attention and enjoy learning about manufacturing methods and material science!

360 is hard and I thought it was boring but he really cares about your success and he is super funny and makes the class tolerable. He really tests your abilities with some tough projects and homework, but he clearly wants you to get an A and actually learn the material. He's a good dude and you will learn materials science, but you have to earn it

Dr. Balawi is great! He gives great lectures and provides slides with examples. His quizzes, lectures, projects, and exams all somewhat line up. He drops a quiz and gives extra credit for participation. Materials isn't my favorite but I actually learned a ton in this class and he made it very fun
Dr. Balawi's lectures pair well with the text and really clear things up. Be careful of quizzes & exams as they are very qualitative and are a NEEDED basis for later courses involving a lot of math.

Very kind, funny, interesting to listen to... but I often felt unprepared for his quizzes, homeworks, projects, exams, etc. 

Weekly quizzes, lots of homework, projects, lab work, etc. These were often assigned with no more than 2 or 3 days til completion or we would be taught the material on the due date.

Dr. Balawi is probably a great guy to work within the industry, but as a professor he's not the best. The material is very hard and lectures were sometimes very boring and long. He has a good passion and heart in the class, but I think the way the class is organized makes it way harder than it has to be. Get a quizlet ready for each exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Balawi is my all-time favorite professor. I had him every morning at 8 (had him for 363 and 368) last semester, and he made it worth the time. Hilarious anecdotes, light sense of humor, and very well informed on the topics he teaches. Tests in this class are surprisingly relaxed on grades, but accounted for 85% of total grade, so be careful.

Lectures are incomplete / missing steps that are important. I personally thought i failed every test I took, but if you show all of your work, he gives tons of partial credit, allowing me to get A's and B's. The most important thing is practice, Understand the HW and you'll be good. (Use tutor paul, he is free and saved my life in this class)
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He makes lectures irrelevant to quizzes and exams. Only prof to give pop quizzes for this class. Shadi is definitely not a melody in my head or my gpa.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures do not prepare you for the homework, quizzes or exams. Homework does not line up with either quizzes or exams. Exams are way too long for the time you are given. You're better off trying another prof or pushing this class to another semester. It is an utter disaster.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Your Mileage May Vary in this class (some people find it more difficult than others). That being said he made the concepts really easy to understand and gave a good amount of examples to make sure we were prepared. The HWs were helpful, the quizzes were hard but only 5% of your grade. Exams: Focus on showing process. Overall great professor

Dr. Balawi says he does not want you to memorize stuff for exams but then makes the exams about memorization. He is great at teaching the important stuff, but skips on the smaller things that are still in exams.

His lectures were boring and way too long. Once lectures moved to online, one powerpoint had 70 slides (most filled with useless graphs that didn't help on exams or hw). Exams and quizzes are difficult. He expects you to have a lot of things memorized. Not a bad guy but a mediocre prof.

Beware of this course His midterm and final were a regurgitation of memorized information from the textbook, not much engineering knowledge required. His quiz do not follow the lecture. So unless you are a good writer and with your materials science vocab, you can forget about learning or even doing well. Curved down as well and blindsided final.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Course content: interesting. Work load: atrocious - homework and projects. Midterm/Final: nothing like the homework or slides. Quizzes: nothing like homework or slides. Not a good prof to learn from and do not rely on a good grade. Avoid to save your GPA, learning, and time. Useless in industry (I have materials position). Save your sanity please.

This man is the definition of memorization as supposed to thinking on your own. His midterm was 40 T/F, 20 MC, 12 short answer, and 4 free response. His short answer require you to draw phase diagrams and graph memorized from any part of the book. Avoid at all costs. No time to finish the exam. He only cares about answer, no credit otherwise wrong
Never been so happy to horribly flunk the final but still pass. This man's lectures and class is absolute chaos. And thank god I got through it. Avoid at all costs

He give extra credit, but the links are broken (no way to submit). Way too much work for design project and homeworks. His exams and quizzes are worth a lot and the grading and content are both shad(y)i

Dr. Balawi makes an already difficult subject even more difficult. If you struggled in MEEN 222, do not think about taking. No partial credit. Exams and quizzes are brutal. You will need to thoroughly read text in order to do well. High chance you will fail everything and will not learn. Saving grace is extra credit, although it is a ton of work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is still a fairly easy lab even after they added the scissor lift project.
Extra credit was given for attendance. Shadi was really funny.

Dr. Balawi is one of those professors who are passionate about what he teaches and will go out of his way to meet with students outside of lecture and office hours. He will definitely make you work for it but this is mechanical engineering and so there isn't any easy upper level courses. Show up to class, ask questions, do your homework.

225 is going to be hard no matter who you have. Having said that Balawi is a very good professor and understands all of the concepts very well. I would definitely recommend for 225 and later classes because he really does try his best to let you know what will be on the tests. His final had almost all exact problems from the practice tests.

Great professor, you can tell he really puts in an effort to make the class as interesting as possible. You will have to read the textbook for 360, but his lectures guide you really well to go about it. Dr. Balawi is a great choice for 360, exams are reasonable and he grades fairly generously. The class is also quiz and project heavy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Statics & Dynamics is a challenging class, but Balawi makes this class easier to understand. Projects, take home tests, and homework is assigned weekly which can be very time consuming. If you understand PHYS 218 the first half of the semester won't be that bad, but one you get to dynamics it is all new material. Good choice for 225
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Balawi is actually a good professor, but MEEN 225 is just a lot of work. The homework for this class, coupled with the weekend tests and projects, make this class take up a lot of time. Dr. Balawi did his best to explain the concepts in lecture, but with all the material you have to learn, he just didn't really have time.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is an extension of Mechanics. If you have a good foundation, you will be fine. He knows what he's doing and really tries to teach from a students point of view. He is easy to talk to and knows where students often make mistakes so he stresses a lot where to be careful when solving problems. Would definitely recommend him though.

Shadi is a solid choice for a MEEN 221 professor. All the stuff he goes over in class is more foundation than anything, and applies to the much harder homework and test questions. The textbook is technically used for homework although I never opened it. Lots of quizzes in class though that could really make or break your grade!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES
